pell.name: Pell
pell.who: the ferry child (recurring, shared across levels)

tamsin.name: Tamsin
tamsin.who: the mapmaker, camped by the river

verse.name: Verse-stone
verse.who: the Ink-maker's words, spoken when a verse-stone is bloomed

card.who: a pickup card: no speaker, shown on the paper panel

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: talk to Pell on the jetty at the landing, beside the raft (first time)
lines: Sedge Plain. Mind the holes. They bite.
I'll pole round through the trees and wait where the brook comes out of the [wood].
If you hear someone shouting at the wind, that's the mapmaker. She's harmless. Mostly.

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: talk to Pell on the jetty again
lines: Go on. I'll be at the brook by the [wood]. Ears ready.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at her camp (first time)
lines: Oh! A fox. A paper fox. Are you lost as well?
Don't answer that. Nobody out here answers.
I'm Tamsin. I map this plain. Mapped it. Was mapping it.
Then the black came up in the low places, and the wind took my map clean off the frame.
Three leaves, and every one blew into a hollow. Of course it did.
The first went north, past the [Leaning Stones], toward the gully. The [Seam], I call it.
Bring it back and I'll draw you. From the good side.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin on the rim before the first leaf is found
lines: The leaf went down by the Mere's rim, just east of here. Bring it and I'll show you where we are.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at her camp again, before leaf 1
lines: North, past the stones. The leaf is the one thing out there that isn't sedge.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom on the verse-stone by the first bridge; the Tie prompt follows
lines: I carried soot across this plain each spring.
Where the ground split, I strung a rope from post to post.
One straight line and two good posts make a bridge.
I made a thousand. I never made one home.

scenes.speaker: card
scenes.trigger: pick up the first leaf on the Mere's south rim
lines: A leaf of Tamsin's map: most of the plain, and a hole where the middle should be.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim (she crosses the first bridge once it is tied and waits at M_Tamsin_Rim)
lines: You tied the bridge! I walked over it with my eyes shut. Both of them.
That's my first leaf. Look: there's the [Mere], and the Knoll in the middle of it.
There used to be a road out to the Knoll. My map knows where. My map is in three pieces.
The second leaf is east, out on the island in [Kettle Hollow]. The causeway's under soot.
Soot blows away, I'm told. Do you blow?

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim again, with one leaf
lines: East, to Kettle Hollow. Blow the soot off the causeway and walk out to the island.

scenes.speaker: card
scenes.trigger: reach the end of a false spur in the Mere (either spur), once
lines: The old road stops here, in the black. This isn't the way.

scenes.speaker: card
scenes.trigger: pick up the second leaf on Kettle Hollow's island
lines: The second leaf: a road leaves the rim for the Knoll, then runs off the edge of the page.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim with two leaves
lines: Kettle Hollow! I named it. It whistles when the wind's in the south.
The last leaf went west, back over the gully, into [Ladle Hollow]. Yes, I named that one too.

scenes.speaker: card
scenes.trigger: pick up the third leaf on Ladle Hollow's island
lines: The third leaf: two bends, a gap, and the Knoll.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim with all three leaves; afterwards the soot at the Mere causeway can be blown away
lines: All three! Hold still, I need your nose to pin the corner.
There. The old road goes in by the [leaning post], bends twice, and jumps a gap before the Knoll.
The soot at the start is thick. Blow hard. Then [tie] the gap the way you tied the gully.
I'd come along, but someone has to hold the map. Also I'm scared of the black. Mostly the second thing.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim again, before the Knoll is restored
lines: In by the leaning post, two bends, tie the gap. I'll be right here. Holding the map. Bravely.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom on the verse-stone on the Knoll (it stands by the sapling; it can be read before or after the fight)
lines: I boiled this sedge for green when I was young.
The green ran out of every pot I filled.
So I began to grind a black to keep it in.
The plain kept its green without me. I should have asked it how.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin at the rim after the plain is restored
lines: Look at it. Every hollow green right to the bottom.
I finished the map. Here's the river, all the way up past the [wood].
And here's the mountain, and here is... nothing. I have never once drawn nothing.
Somebody up there makes ink. Lots of it. I could smell it on the wind before the black came.
Take the path north-west, down to the brook. Your ferry child is waiting there. Loudly.

scenes.speaker: tamsin
scenes.trigger: talk to Tamsin again after the restoration
lines: North-west, through the trees. Come back and I'll draw you. I did say the good side. I meant it.

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: reach the raft on the brook pool at the edge of the wood (M_Exit); the level ends after it
lines: There you are. The whole plain went green behind you. I saw it from the water.
In you get. It's dark under those trees, so hold on to your ears.

prompts.trigger: first time the black ground pushes Orimi back
prompts.text: The black ground won't let you in. Look for the raised road.

prompts.trigger: standing at a soot bank on a causeway
prompts.text: Soot buries the road. A [Gust] will clear it.

prompts.trigger: Gust on the Mere's soot before Tamsin has read the map
prompts.text: The soot here won't shift. Tamsin's map might show the way.

prompts.trigger: HUD counter while leaves are out

bead.text: The plain remembers its colour: [sedge green].
